body.statement: For \(A=((1/8,3/8),(3/8,1/8))\) and \(B=((3/8,1/8),(3/8,1/8))\), both tables are strictly positive, \(cL=cU=1/8\), and \(QI(A,B)=[3/8,5/8]\); the two endpoints admit finite certificates satisfying all eight cells and mutual root independence.
body.justification: This pinned-fiber instance is the earliest destructive check on the universal extension at a compatibility boundary.
body.gap: A numerical endpoint alone would not verify that the same deterministic outcome law reproduces both complete tables.
body.consumer: The example is a fixed exact regression test for implementations of the certificate generator.
